key_insight: Process-zone condensation reproduces the full discretized cell response without training while the eliminated matrix region remains elastic.
engineering_relevance: The method can accelerate FE² analysis of composites with fibre–matrix debonding and matrix plasticity while preserving stress and consistent-tangent accuracy.
method: Schur-condense the linear elastic remainder, retaining interface and process-zone internal variables.
Recover macroscopic stress and consistent tangent using influence matrices.
Check the eliminated matrix region by back-substitution each increment; expand the retained zone when needed.
evidence_signal: Eight of nine 2D paths matched full-cell stress and tangent to 1e-11, with the ninth flagged; aggregate 2D speed-up was 3.3× excluding setup and checks, while plate FE² achieved 1.51× for glass/polypropylene.
watch_item: Speed-up depends on zone size, active set and adaptation costs: certified 3D zones showed no gain, and glass/epoxy plate FE² was slower.
paper_title: Process-zone condensation: a discretization-exact reduced cell model for FE$^2$ analysis of composites with fibre-matrix debonding and matrix plasticity
